title: The People Element: Leadership, Teams, Communication and Integration

header.html: Explain the difference between leadership and management; explain stakeholder engagement, communication, and effective teams including diversity, capability and competence; explain the purpose of the change management approach and the communication management approach; explain how people aspects integrate with the other PRINCE2 elements
the official PRINCE2 7 Foundation syllabus (PeopleCert), learning outcome 3

toc.title: How people aspects fit with the other elements

html:
1Effective teams

An effective team has clear roles, shared objectives, trust and good communication. PRINCE2 7 stresses three things:

Quality Meaning
Diversity A mix of backgrounds, skills and views gives better ideas and fewer blind spots
Capability The team has the ability and capacity (skills, tools, time) to do the work
Competence Individuals can actually do the tasks assigned to them, in practice
Exam tip

. Capability = can the team do it (resources, skills in the team). Competence = can this person do it (demonstrated ability). Both matter; diversity adds the range of views.

2Communication

Communication is the exchange of information that keeps people informed, aligned and engaged. Good project communication is two-way, planned, timely and fitted to the audience and its needs.

The communication management approach (a PID product) records who needs what information, when, how and from whom, and how feedback is received.

Management product Purpose
Change management approach How the project will help people adopt the change
Communication management approach How the project will communicate with stakeholders and the team

Both are parts of the PID (project initiation documentation).

3How people aspects fit with the other elements

With How
Principles Principles such as define roles and learn from experience depend on people behaving well
Practices Each practice has people actions: for example, organizing sets roles, issues and risk need an open culture, progress needs honest reporting
Processes People make the decisions and do the work in every process
Project context Culture and environment shape how people work and how tailoring is done

The point: PRINCE2 is applied by people; a plan or report is only as good as the engagement and honesty behind it.

Exam tip

. Change management approach and communication management approach are PID products. Neither is a report or a log.

Exam tip

. Competence belongs to the individual; capability belongs to the team or organization.

4Exam Q&A

4.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1A team has enough skills and time to deliver, but one member cannot yet use a key tool. Which concept is this about?

  • ATeam capability only
  • BIndividual competence
  • CStage boundaries
  • DProject tolerance
Show the answer

Answer: B. Whether an individual can do the task in practice is competence.

S2Which statements about the two management products supporting the people element are CORRECT? (1) The change management approach says how the project helps people adopt the change. (2) The communication management approach says who needs what information and when. (3) Both are parts of the end project report. (4) Both are produced only at project closure.

  • A1 and 2
  • B3 and 4
  • C2 and 3
  • D1 and 4
Show the answer

Answer: A. Both are parts of the PID, and those are their purposes.

S3Identify the missing word. A team that brings together different backgrounds, skills and views shows [ ? ].

  • ADiversity
  • BTolerance
  • CDelegation
  • DBaselining
Show the answer

Answer: A. A mix of views and backgrounds is diversity.

S4Why does PRINCE2 7 treat people as an element in its own right?

  • ABecause processes no longer matter
  • BBecause principles are optional
  • CBecause stakeholders are not important
  • DBecause projects succeed or fail through people
Show the answer

Answer: D. People are essential to project success.

S5A project manager sends the same long report to everyone, whatever they need. Which communication quality is missing?

  • AFit to the audience's needs
  • BA project board
  • CA stage plan
  • DA product register
Show the answer

Answer: A. Communication should fit the audience and be planned.

S6Which element describes how culture and environment shape the way PRINCE2 is applied?

  • AProject context
  • BPrinciples
  • CPractices
  • DProcesses
Show the answer

Answer: A. The project context shapes tailoring.

4.2 Recall questions

R1Name three qualities of an effective team that PRINCE2 7 stresses.

Show the answer

Diversity, capability and competence.

R2What does the communication management approach record?

Show the answer

Who needs what information, when, how and from whom.

R3What is the change management approach for?

Show the answer

How the project will help people adopt the change.

R4Is communication one-way or two-way?

Show the answer

Two-way and planned.

R5Which document are the two approaches part of?

Show the answer

The PID.

R6Which element does culture belong to?

Show the answer

The project context (and the people element).

5Quick Reference Card

Topic Key fact
Team qualities diversity, capability, competence
Communication two-way, planned, timely, fit to the audience
Approaches change and communication management approaches, parts of the PID
Integration people connect principles, practices, processes and context
